name: gear-knit-scarf-skitter
prompt: The reference image shows a small bug creature with a broad low dome body, much wider than tall. Do NOT draw the creature. Draw ONLY a cozy knit scarf, alone on the background, shaped exactly as if it were wrapped fully AROUND this creature's wide dome body: the band spans the ENTIRE width of the dome in a wide shallow arc, and both ends curve backward and taper away as if disappearing behind the creature's sides — the wrap must read as going around the body, not lying on top of it. One short tail hangs down from the front-right of the band, ending in yarn fringe tassels. Sticker-flat cel style, every region ONE perfectly even solid color like a vector illustration — no shading variation, no wash, no mottling — one thick confident uniform rounded outline in a darker wine shade of the scarf's own color, never black. The ENTIRE scarf filled with deep muted berry red (#a34b54) — a dark, rich, saturated wine red, NOT pink, NOT pastel — with soft warm cream (#f2e9d3) for a few flat stitch dashes and the fringe. Scarf centered and large in frame, 10% margin, on a plain solid magenta (#ff00ff) background, no shadow. Negative constraints: no pink, no pastel colors, no gray, no gradients, no texture, no stipple, no halftone, no watercolor, no 3d render, no clay, no cast shadow, no drop shadow, no background scenery, no creature, no body, no face, no eyes, no legs, no outline sketchiness, no black outline, no text, no watermark, no sticker border, no die-cut white edge.
